name: Example SEO Agent
description: An A2A-compliant agent that analyses web pages for SEO and AI-search readiness, returning structured recommendations.

skills.name: Analyse Page SEO
skills.description: Fetches a URL and returns a structured report covering title, meta description, headings, internal links, and structured data presence.
examples: Check the meta tags on this page

skills.name: Check AI Search Readiness
skills.description: Evaluates whether a page is discoverable and citable by AI search engines, including robots.txt access for retrieval bots, llms.txt presence, and content structure.
examples: Is this page citable by ChatGPT?
Check AI crawler access for my site

skills.name: Generate Structured Data
skills.description: Produces JSON-LD structured data recommendations based on page content type (Article, Product, FAQ, HowTo, Organization).
examples: Generate Article schema for this blog post
What schema should I add to my pricing page?
